$comment: Built-in personas; a journey map's personas are added to these. ids are what charters cite.

first_time.name: First-time customer
first_time.notes: No saved details, reads every label, follows the happy path literally.

power_user.name: Power user
power_user.notes: Keyboard shortcuts, several tabs, bulk actions, goes fast.

keyboard_only.name: Keyboard-only user
keyboard_only.notes: No mouse: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, arrow keys.

screen_reader.name: Screen reader user
screen_reader.notes: NVDA or VoiceOver; listens to names, roles, states and announcements.

slow_network.name: Slow or flaky network
slow_network.notes: Throttled to 3G, drops the connection mid-action, retries.

adversarial.name: Adversarial user
adversarial.notes: Edits requests, replays them, uses other people's ids, races two tabs.

support_agent.name: Support agent
support_agent.notes: Acts on a customer's behalf from the back office; sees more data than a customer.
